name: ISAIC - Industrial Sewing and Innovation Center
old_description: We are dedicated to revolutionizing the textile and apparel industry through standardizing a human-centered approach to innovative manufacturing and skilling.
about:
ISAIC, the Industrial Sewing and Innovation Center, operates from Detroit, Michigan. The organization was founded in Detroit, though a specific year is not publicly disclosed. It functions as an innovation hub rather than a traditional factory, governed by a mission to standardize a human-centered approach to manufacturing and workforce development in the textile and apparel sector.

The center focuses on innovative manufacturing practices and skilling programs, running innovation pilots and training people both at its Detroit facility and nationally. It maintains a network of local partners and licensees, though specific facility size, headcount, or production volumes are not disclosed. Its work emphasizes integrating people and technology to advance processes and practices.

ISAIC serves the textile and apparel industry, engaging with donors, partners, investors, and licensees who support its mission. Its model appears designed to transform the sector through collaborative innovation rather than direct contract manufacturing for external clients.

The organization distinguishes itself by centering human capital alongside technology, aiming to create a standardized, replicable framework for modern apparel manufacturing. Its founding premise is that sustainable industry transformation requires investing in people as much as in equipment.
